text:
maya: quick FYI — CI flagged a ~40% increase in the Python wheel size for sdk v1.4 on the release branch. Can packaging owners take a look? @sam @tanvi :eyes:

sam: ack. pinging packaging + deps. do we have the artifact link and the diff?

maya: artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/ci/sdk/v1.4/wheels/sdk-1.4.0.whl (CI log attached). The size bump shows up between build #412 and #413.

ci-bot: build 413 artifacts: wheel 8.9MB (+40% from 6.3MB). changed files in that build:
```
M  src/sdk/__init__.py
A  samples/large-demo-model.bin
M  setup.cfg
```

tanvi: whoa, that `samples/large-demo-model.bin` slipped in by accident — looks like it was added to the package manifest in https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 :exclamation:

noah: if it's just sample assets being accidentally packaged we can remove them from `package_data` in `setup.cfg` and cut a patch. tagging @olivia for docs impact (sample size referenced in quickstart?).

olivia: thanks for the tag. quickstart referenced the small demo file for examples, but we can switch to a hosted download instead of bundling. I'll update the quickstart text + note in the changelog.

sam: proposed actions:
1) revert packaging change in PR 1234 or update packaging to exclude `samples/large-demo-model.bin`
2) regenerate wheel and rerun smoke CI
3) release manager to decide whether this needs a rollback from dist (if any customers already pulled)

maya: +1. I can prepare a small PR that strips the sample out of the wheel and leaves a placeholder script that downloads the heavy demo at runtime. Will open in the next 30m.

tanvi: I can review the PR fast. Also can we add a check to the build pipeline to fail if artifacts exceed X MB? We keep hitting surprise regressions.

noah: we already have a size gate script in infra (infra/scripts/check_artifact_size.sh). It's not wired into this job though. I'll file a quick job update to include it in the wheel build stage.

ci-bot: ticket created: INFRA-987 - wire artifact size gate into sdk wheel job.

maya: OK PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1238 — removes the large file from package_data and adds a download helper.

sam: reviewing now. if people can +1 by EOD we can cut a patch release tomorrow morning.

olivia: I'll push the quickstart wording edit to a draft branch and link it to the PR.

tanvi: also dropping a note in the changelog that the sample was moved out of the wheel to reduce package size. keep the changelog short, under the breaking section.

maya: thanks everyone. follow-ups: @noah INFRA-987, @sam please coord with release mgr, @olivia update quickstart. I'll update the release checklist once PR passes. :thumbsup:
